title: Zcash's NU7 Upgrade Goes Live, Recycling 60% of Fees to Fund Future Block Rewards
summary: The Network Sustainability Mechanism will reissue removed ZEC from 2031 within the 21 million cap, as the community debates its dev fund.

title: Zcash NU7 upgrade goes live, leaves 12,224 ZEC stranded in Sprout pool
summary: Zcash’s NU7 upgrade has rendered about $15 million in legacy Sprout funds unspendable, although a future network upgrade could potentially restore access.

title: Zcash’s major network upgrade NU7 goes live on mainnet, cutting block time by threefold
summary: NU7 also activates the Network Sustainability Mechanism, which removes 60% of each block's transaction fees from circulation.

title: Zcash’s landmark NU7 upgrade goes live, speeding up private payments
summary: NU7 cuts the target time between blocks to 25 seconds, reduces the work wallets must do to find private payments and sets aside fees for future miners.

title: Zcash Upgrade Could Lock $16 Million in Crypto Forever
summary: Zcash's latest upgrade promises faster transactions, but thousands of coins remain in an aging privacy system that will soon stop accepting withdrawals, potentially leaving their owners empty-handed.
